info.title: Provider API for Invoicing
info.description:
Provides functionality for managing invoicing process when integrating SAP Logistics Business Network with other systems.
This specification describes the API from the perspective of SAP Logistics Business Network as the provider of the API.
Other systems call the defined endpoints within SAP Logistics Business Network.

x-sap-shortText: Enables carriers to manage invoicing process.

x-servers.description: Invoice API endpoint for EU10 data center
Invoice API endpoint for US20 data center

externalDocs.description: Click here to access detailed implementation documentation.

eu10.description:
To use the EU10 data center API, you must obtain the OAuth client credentials (client ID and secret). 
To get the OAuth client credentials, create a customer incident on SAP support portal with the component as SBN-LBN-INT. 
Provide the SAP Business Network for Logistics ID created for your account and the email address to receive your client credentials. 
Specify the target integration platform as ‘Multi-Cloud (new)’ and the title as ‘SAP BN4L Integration Platform Migration: Request for new OAuth 2.0 credential’. 
Once you receive the credentials, pass the details to SAP HANA Cloud Platform token endpoint to obtain an access token.

post.summary: Public API for carrier to create an invoice request.

grossAmount.description: Enter the total amount of all items in a carrier invoice including the tax amount. Specifies the gross invoice amount in the document currency.

grossAmountCurrency.description:
Enter the currency of gross amount.
Format must be compliant with SAP Global Data Type `CurrencyCode` (`listID` = `4217`, `listAgencyID` = `5`).

orderingPartyLbnId.description: Identifier of the ordering party in SAP Logistics Business Network system.

carrierLbnId.description: Identifier of the carrier in SAP Logistics Business Network system.

purchasingParty.description: Specify the ordering party in the shipper's system.

billFromParty.description: Specify the carrier in the shipper's system.

totalTaxAmount.description: Enter the total amount of all tax lines included in an invoice.

taxAmountCurrency.description:
Specify the currency of tax amount.
Format must be compliant with SAP Global Data Type `CurrencyCode` (`listID` = `4217`, `listAgencyID` = `5`).

senderSystemId.description: Unique identifier of the shipper system

items.description: Specify the charge items in the invoice.

documentReferences.description: Document references present in the invoice.

notes.description: Specify additional information about the carrier invoice.

attachments.description: Specify attachments in a binary format.

BaseDocumentType.description:
Specify the type of base document.
"1122" - Freight order document
"610" - Freight booking document

documentTypeCode.description: A coded representation of the type of business document that is referenced. [Codelist](https://help.sap.com/docs/business-network-freight-collaboration/code-lists/document-reference-type-codes)

documentId.description: An identifier for a referenced business document.

grossAmount.description: Specify the total amount of the underlying pricing elements in the document currency including the tax amount.

grossAmountCurrency.description:
Specify the currency of gross amount.
Format must be compliant with SAP Global Data Type `CurrencyCode` (`listID` = `4217`, `listAgencyID` = `5`).

freightDocumentID.description: Identifier of the freight document used in the invoice. Contains the freight document number in the shipper's system.

transportationItemID.description: Identifier of a cargo item. Contains the item ID of the freight document item in the shipper's system if the invoice item is for a freight document item. Only required when the calculation level in SAP TM for the carrier is item level.

transportationStageID.description: Identifier of a stage. Holds the sender system stage ID. Only required when the calculation level in SAP TM for the carrier is stage level. Contains the stage ID of the freight document stage in the shipper's system if the invoice item is for a freight document stage.

alternateIDCategory.description:
Specifies the type of alternate ID used to identify the freight document.
When provided, only the following values are allowed:
  - MBL_CONTAINERID
  - BOOKINGREF_CONTAINERID

typeCode.description:
A coded representation of the type of alternate ID provided.[Codelist](https://help.sap.com/docs/business-network-freight-collaboration/code-lists/document-reference-type-codes)
  Allowed Values – Description:
    -T52: Master Bill of Lading
    -CONT: Container ID
    -BREF: Booking Reference

id.description: An identifier for an alternate ID.

taxCode.description: Enter the supplier tax type code.

taxAmount.description: Enter the tax amount in document currency.

taxAmountCurrency.description:
Specify the currency of tax amount.
Format must be compliant with SAP Global Data Type `CurrencyCode` (`listID` = `4217`, `listAgencyID` = `5`).

lbnChargeCode.description: Enter the charge code maintained in SAP Business Network for Logistics. Please contact your shipper for the charge code that they have maintained in their Assign Charge Codes app. Note that you must enter only the code and not the description.

rateAmount.description: Specify the rate agreed with the carrier.

rateAmountCurrency.description:
Specify the currency of rate amount.
Format must be compliant with SAP Global Data Type `CurrencyCode` (`listID` = `4217`, `listAgencyID` = `5`).

finalAmount.description: Enter the invoice amount for the component invoiced by the carrier in document currency.

finalAmountCurrency.description:
Specify the currency of final amount.
Format must be compliant with SAP Global Data Type `CurrencyCode` (`listID` = `4217`, `listAgencyID` = `5`).

quantityUnit.description:
Specify the unit of quantity.
Format must be compliant with `Common Codes` specified in UN/CEFACT Recommendation #20.

priceUnitUoM.description:
Specify the unit of measure of price unit.
Format must be compliant with `Common Codes` specified in UN/CEFACT Recommendation #20.

logisticalContext.description: Enter the logistical reference value of the charge line. Logistical reference displays the header or item or stage information for a charge line (for the resolution base of container, package, product, stage, etc) from which the system obtains the logistical data.

LogisticalContextType.description: Enter the logistical reference type. Enter a value specified in enum.

text.description: Enter additional information about the carrier invoice.

fileName.description: Specify the name of the attachment.

mimeType.description:
Content type code of the attachment.
* image/jpg - MIME type for image files with .jpg extension
* image/jpeg - MIME type for image files with .jpeg extension
* image/png - MIME type for image files with .png extension
* image/gif - MIME type for image files with .gif extension
* image/tiff - MIME type for image files with the .tif (Windows) or .tiff (Mac) extension
* image/tiff-fx - MIME type for image files with the .tfx extension (Windows and Mac)
* application/pdf - MIME type for files with .pdf extension
* application/msword - MIME type for files with .doc extension
* application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document - MIME type for files with .docx extension
* application/vnd.ms-excel - MIME type for files with .xls extension
* application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet - MIME type for files with .xlsx extension

fileContentBinaryObject.description: Enter the attachment content in binary format. Note that the maximum size of the attachment must not exceed 5 MB.

DateTimeType.description:
Enter the date of creation of invoice. Note even when you enter the date and time in this field, the system only displays the date in the external transportation system.
Format must be compliant with RFC 3339 internet date/time format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ)
